intro: Elo Coffee Table brings bold geometry and natural warmth in a striking triangular form. Built from solid mango wood, it offers a centrepiece that feels distinctive, grounded, and refined.

features.title: Long-lasting solid wood build
features.text: Elo is crafted entirely from solid mango wood, ensuring a structure that feels stable, reliable, and reassuring in daily use. Its sturdy construction supports long-term durability without compromising on style.

features.title: Triangular tabletop for a modern look
features.text: The distinctive triangular tabletop sets this coffee table apart with a modern, sculptural presence. This unconventional shape adds visual interest while creating a dynamic focal point in living spaces.

features.title: Refined Form with a touch of grandeur
features.text: Clean lines, bold geometry, and solid materials come together harmoniously. This coffee table introduces a subtle sense of grandeur while maintaining a composed and contemporary aesthetic.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
